name: wordpress-chatbot-plugin
description: Standalone WordPress connector plugin for the centralized chatbot platform.

scripts.package: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path dist) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path dist | Out-Null; Compress-Archive -Path wordpress-chatbot.php,README.md,readme.txt,public,admin,assets,includes,languages -DestinationPath dist/wordpress-chatbot-plugin.zip -Force"
